description: This Kotlin source file defines a SplashActivity for an Android TV application. The activity displays a themed splash screen with no user interaction, preloads an image into cache for smoother rendering, and transitions to the MainActivity after a 3-second delay. It manages lifecycle correctly by removing pending callbacks in onDestroy to prevent memory leaks.

classes.name: SplashActivity
classes.description: An Android FragmentActivity that displays a splash screen, preloads an image, and transitions to MainActivity after a delay.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, preloads an image into cache, and schedules the transition to MainActivity after 3 seconds.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Removes any pending callbacks to prevent memory leaks when the activity is destroyed.
